cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your opening had empty seats? Mine had two people, and both left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Have my complimentary drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Thank you. My theatre couldn't even afford to console us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you listen now? My dad left before my scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine asked for a refund. Could you stay while I finish this? I haven't told anyone that.
